Q: Doeas analytics have 3 months limitation to search engine optimization screen A:

Fuerte Developers uses Google Analytics and Google Search Console to monitor website traffic and search engine optimization (SEO) performance.

At Fuerte Developers, we found that Google Analytics does not have a 3-month data limitation. It stores website traffic data from the time it is installed, and we can view reports for any time period such as 6 months, 1 year, or more.

However, for SEO and search keyword performance, Fuerte Developers uses Google Search Console. In this tool, the Search Performance report shows only recent data (approximately the last 3 months). This is a limitation of Google Search Console and not a limitation of our website or business.

So in our business:

  • Website traffic data → No 3-month limit (Google Analytics)

  • SEO keyword and search performance data → Limited to recent history (Google Search Console)

Because of this, Fuerte Developers uses:

  • Google Analytics for long-term traffic analysis

  • Google Search Console for recent SEO performance tracking

Q: Website not working in Firefox/Chrome, but does in IE A:

I'm also facing the same problem(Javascript broke). The solution I found is to just add https:// before the link and reload the page and everything will work fine again.

Q: UnsatisfiedLinkError: no j3dcore-ogl in java.library.path A:

If I set export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$LD_LIBRARY_PATH:/usr/lib/jni it works.

Q: ADB shell script to send AT commands to a modem-cannot return control to a shell and capture output A:

I had similar problems with redirecting output to file. I resolved my problem by adding CMD /c in front of the echo command. I.e. if I understand correctly you need to tell the system that it needs to wait until command finishes executing and only then redirect output to a file. I was doing it in DOS.

Since you are running on ANDROID try adding sh -c in front of your command. Hope it helps.
